steps.name: Launch screen
steps.goal: If a system alert such as Apple Account Verification is showing, tap Not Now. Otherwise wait and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The launch screen shows Boxy and the caption Connecting to your computer.

steps.name: Live list
steps.done: The launch screen is gone. The harness shows Stage: Live and the fake session list with nothing over it.

steps.name: Brief drop stays silent
steps.done: The harness shows Stage: Brief drop and the list, with no connection page, pill or card over it.

steps.name: Long drop takes the full page
steps.done: A full page covers the list: Boxy in the middle and the caption Reconnecting to your computer. There is no Try again button. The list is not visible.

steps.name: First connect
steps.done: The full page reads Connecting to your computer, with no buttons.

steps.name: Paused wakes by itself
steps.done: The full page reads Waking your computer, with no buttons.

steps.name: Long wait explains itself
steps.done: The full page reads Waking your computer and, under it, Still working. This can take up to a minute. There are no buttons yet.
expect: Still working. This can take up to a minute.

steps.name: After a minute there is a way out
steps.done: The full page offers Try again and Choose another computer under Connecting to your computer.

steps.name: Choose another works
steps.done: The text Choose another tapped is on screen.

steps.name: Unavailable computer
steps.done: The full page reads Your computer is not available, with Try again and Choose another computer.

steps.name: Offline
steps.done: The full page reads Could not reach your computer, with Try again.

steps.name: Recovered socket
steps.done: The harness shows Stage: Recovered and the list, with no connection page over it.
